title: Scaling Agentic Capabilities via Grounded Interaction Synthesis
creator: Shi W.
source_title: Proceedings of the ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining
normalized_title: scaling agentic capabilities via grounded interaction synthesis
V65_REASON: GAIS constructs protocol-anchored MCP environments and structure-guided/adversarial tasks to synthesize agent training data. Its object is scalable capability/data synthesis and benchmark performance, not preservation, verification, enforcement, or restoration of a deployed agent's consequential decision across execution/effect boundaries.

title: ETOM: A Five-Level Benchmark for Evaluating Tool Orchestration within the MCP Ecosystem
creator: Dong J.K.
source_title: 19th Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics Findings of Eacl 2026
normalized_title: etom a five level benchmark for evaluating tool orchestration within the mcp ecosystem
V65_REASON: ETOM is a five-level benchmark for multi-hop end-to-end MCP tool orchestration, evaluating selection, cross-server planning, functional overlap and out-of-scope robustness using objective ground truth. It diagnoses orchestration failures but does not itself enforce or restore decision validity at execution.

title: ScaleMCP: Dynamic and Auto-synchronizing Model Context Protocol Tools for LLM Agents
creator: Lumer E.
source_title: Communications in Computer and Information Science
normalized_title: scalemcp dynamic and auto synchronizing model context protocol tools for llm agents
V65_REASON: ScaleMCP dynamically retrieves and auto-synchronizes MCP tools using MCP servers as the single source of truth and supports re-querying during multi-turn interaction. This addresses stale/inconsistent tool repositories and selection scalability, but the evidence does not establish validation of the agent's consequential decision premises or authority immediately before action.
